title: Proving Ground
description: A wolf pack has denned east of the Thornfield road. It has killed two merchants this month, and I am out of local hands willing to go near it. Clear the den and bring me proof.

objectives.description: Clear the wolf den east of the Thornfield road

notes: Rank: Initiate. Basic combat test. Wolves spawn on roads between Dalhurst and Thornfield. Threat: a wolf pack has killed two merchants on the Thornfield road this month. Giver motive: Vorn's only asset is the Guild's reputation and he will not vouch for an untested stranger. Consequence: failing or refusing means no membership and the road stays bad; no second path to wire, this is a combat-only entry test. Known duplicate pair with guild_initiation (same giver, same wolves) - deliberately differentiated: this is Vorn's own personal test of a walk-in stranger, guild_initiation is a paid contract from a named client (Oda Renn) handed to the newest hire.
